show.description: After a tragic twist shatters her life, a gentle young woman is forced to marry her cold, dangerous brother-in-law to protect her family’s honor. But as buried secrets, forbidden emotions, and past betrayals surface, their unwanted marriage turns into a storm of passion, pain, and destiny.
